**Review of search ad**

- "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" (headline): fine. Matches the allowlisted claim about plastic-free bags.
- "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable.": exact allowlisted wording (supplier certificate, EN 13432). Fine.
- "Recommended by nutritionists.": a problem. It's not on the claims allowlist, so it is an unsupported testimonial/endorsement, and it also implies a health benefit. We have no proof of any nutritionist recommending the tea. Remove it.

Suggested fix: drop the last sentence. If you want a second line, use an allowlisted claim, such as "Free UK delivery on orders over £25."

Approval: Sam (marketing lead) needs to sign off on the revised version before it goes live.
